content.jointProblem: The joint question is whether grammar-guided symbolic regression, trained on TloCare's georeferenced soil laboratory records and available parcel covariates, can produce interpretable sub-field predictions of salinity pockets near the Tisa that prioritize where denser sampling is needed. A first experiment would test this on held-out Tisa parcels against the current 4-ha grid and the earlier NDVI-guided baseline.

rationale.text: Milan explicitly offers joint industry projects on interpretable model discovery from proprietary tabular data, matching TloCare's soil laboratory tables.

sources.quote: joint projects with industry on interpretable model discovery from proprietary tabular data

rationale.text: His group's core research is automated discovery of interpretable mathematical models from tabular data using symbolic regression.

sources.quote: automatsko otkrivanje interpretabilnih matematičkih modela iz tabelarnih podataka primenom simboličke regresije

rationale.text: He has already applied grammar-guided symbolic regression to agronomic tabular data and obtained a compact formula comparable to a random-forest ensemble.

sources.quote: Otkrivena formula sa četiri promenljive postiže R² = 0.81 na test skupu

rationale.text: His methods are designed for small or sparse tabular datasets, relevant when salinity pockets are rare in a coarse grid.

sources.quote: Predictive accuracy differences are modest but consistent in favour of grammar-constrained derivation trees across datasets with fewer than 100 samples

rationale.text: He offers post-hoc uncertainty estimates from ensemble disagreement, useful for flagging where denser sampling is most uncertain.

sources.quote: post-hoc uncertainty quantification method based on disagreement among the top-k expressions retained from the final generation of a grammar-guided GP run

rationale.text: He has industrial experience turning symbolic regression into an audit tool and interpretable models for company use.

sources.quote: Collaborated with a local manufacturing company (injection moulding sector) on a symbolic regression audit tool for quality control prediction models, resulting in a published case study.

rationale.text: The SYMFORM project integrated domain knowledge into the grammar guiding genetic programming, matching the need to encode soil and floodplain knowledge.

sources.quote: integracija ekspertskog znanja o domenu u gramatiku koja vodi prostor pretrage genetskog programiranja

constraints.text: Shared analysis requires a tabular dataset of at least moderate size; TloCare has about 18,000 georeferenced laboratory records over ten years.

sources.quote: Imamo GPS koordinate svih dosadašnjih uzoraka i laboratorijske rezultate za oko 18.000 tačaka iz poslednjih deset godina.
tabular datasets of at least moderate size (>200 rows) are available for shared analysis

constraints.text: The model must resolve salinity pockets of roughly 0.3–0.8 ha, below the current 4-ha grid support.

sources.quote: slani džepovi postoje na površini od svega 0,3 do 0,8 hektara i da ih naša standardna mreža preskače.

constraints.text: Adaptive sampling must not create unacceptable extra field work, laboratory cost, or delivery delay.

sources.quote: gušće uzorkovanje znači više terena, više laboratorijskih troškova i duži rok isporuke

constraints.text: The collaboration should not require real-time embedded system deployment.

sources.quote: not currently available for projects requiring real-time embedded system deployment

constraints.text: Any use of the laboratory GPU cluster for larger experiments needs a formal access agreement with the Faculty of Sciences.

sources.quote: GPU cluster at the laboratory is accessible to external collaborators under a formal agreement with the Faculty of Sciences.

questions: Can Milan Gligorić confirm his availability and expected time commitment, since his availability is currently unknown?
Does the 18,000-point dataset contain a salinity-relevant target such as electrical conductivity, sodium, chloride, pH, or yield-loss labels, and at what spatial support?
Can TloCare share anonymized coordinates, laboratory records, parcel boundaries, terrain/DEM layers, floodplain-deposit maps, weather data, and historical NDVI for shared analysis?
What output and interpretability format do TloCare agronomists need in the portal, and how will adaptive-sampling success be evaluated: pocket detection, field/lab cost, or delivery time?
Will the first experiment use held-out Tisa parcels and compare against both the current grid and the failed NDVI-guided adaptive sampling baseline?
Can TloCare provide field-team validation on selected parcels and, if needed, support an electrical-conductivity or NIR sensor pilot?
